summary: Frontend-only clickable demo for SAURIENT MRV & Independent Verification module tested end-to-end. All 12 tabs load without JS errors; workflow tracker stages navigate correctly; readiness resolve-blockers flow flips KPIs to 100%/0; evidence vault filters + detail drawer + accept/reject work as Verifier; calc review, site visit, findings close, correction accept, technical review, and Release Verified Result all complete successfully. Verified intensity dynamically updates to 2.86 kgCO2e/kg (286 tCO2e) after correction is accepted, and V1.1 is set as the final version. Carbon Passport page unlocks after release (via SPA nav) and passport-create issues the passport with a QR block. Global search, deep links (ACT-0021 -> /pcf/inventory) and back-to-mrv work. Role switcher correctly disables Verifier-only actions (evidence-accept, finding-raise-submit) for Company Operator role.
critical_code_review_comments: State-only architecture: because everything lives in React state (MrvContext), a hard refresh (F5) or any direct URL navigation that triggers a full page load resets the workflow. This is expected per the spec (pure frontend mock, resets on refresh), so no fix needed — but any test/automation that hits /passport directly with page.goto will see the locked screen. Use SPA nav (sidebar buttons) to preserve state.
MrvContext.jsx (~250 lines) is large but acceptable; consider splitting actions vs. selectors into separate hooks if it grows further.
Kpi 'kpi-evidence-accepted' uses a hardcoded offset (169 + counts.accepted - 3) which is fragile if seed data changes — consider deriving from actual data.
All interactive elements consistently expose kebab-case data-testid — excellent testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State is client-only React context. To test the full E2E gate flow you MUST NOT do a hard reload/page.goto between steps; use SPA navigation via sidebar buttons ([data-testid=nav-*]) or tab buttons ([data-testid=tab-*]). Sequence to release: primary-action-btn on readiness -> tab-calculation + primary-action-btn -> tab-sitevisits + primary-action-btn -> tab-findings, open each finding-row-* and click finding-close (4 findings) -> tab-corrections, open correction-row-COR-026-001 and click correction-accept -> tab-report, tr-approve then report-release. After that, nav-carbon-passports -> passport-create issues the passport with a QR block.
